name: opencode-cache-engine
description: Provider-aware prompt-cache optimization and telemetry for OpenCode
author: Alex Joaquim Pereira

scripts.postpublish: VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package').version") && TAG=v$VERSION && echo "Creating git tag $TAG for npm $VERSION" && git tag $TAG && git push origin $TAG || echo "Tag $TAG may already exist or push failed; continuing."
scripts.updateGit: npm uninstall PACKAGE-NAME && npm install git+https://github.com/username/repo.git
